objectClass.notes: Six consistent views isolate the same riderless asset. Hidden geometry is limited to the underside and can be inferred symmetrically.

reasoning: The step-through frame, steering assembly, two wheels, drivetrain, battery, saddle, mudguards, cargo shell and lights form a deep compound hierarchy.
Spokes, tread blocks and reflector accents are repeated systems.
Unity use requires stable wheel and steering pivots, colliders and named sockets.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The asset must remain readable in isometric gameplay while supporting steering and wheel animation in Unity.

definitionOfDone: All six views read as the same compact cargo e-bike with the correct wheelbase, low step-through frame, tall cargo box and teal/cream/orange palette.
Front steering and both wheels have stable animation pivots; cargo and light sockets are named for Unity use.
The optimized GLB stays under 35k triangles, uses no more than six PBR materials and renders cleanly in Blender and Unity.

featureGroups.name: Step-through frame and compact wheelbase
qualityCriteria: The curved teal frame stays low between the wheel centers and rises at the steering column and saddle mast.

featureGroups.name: Rear cargo shell and rack
qualityCriteria: The beveled teal box is centered over the rear wheel and carries a cream parcel emblem, lid seam, latch and orange corner guards.

featureGroups.name: Wheels, fork and steering assembly
qualityCriteria: Both wheels share diameter and cream rims; the front fork, handlebar and light form one steerable hierarchy.

featureGroups.name: Teal cream black and orange material separation
qualityCriteria: Painted teal reads satin, rubber reads matte, cream parts read warm and orange accents stay small and saturated.

visualDeltaChecks: step-through frame curve and negative-space delta
cargo-box width height depth and rack-contact delta
handlebar saddle battery and light placement delta
teal cream black orange palette and roughness delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not merge wheels, steering pivot or cargo box into the chassis.
Do not represent spokes or tire tread as prose only.
Do not continue when a wheel, fork, rack or handlebar has a visible attachment gap.
Do not exceed the real-time triangle and material budget after Blender optimization.

authoringInstruction: Assessment completed from the generated six-view sheet; author the procedural hierarchy and keep the result stylized rather than claiming manufacturing accuracy.
